Senators shaking off doubters with strong start to season

Senators at Red Wings projected lineups
Ottawa Still Feels Like Home for the Emery Family

out.detail: assigned to AHL's Lehigh Valley Phantoms

away.summary: The Flyers (0-2-2) are still seeking their first win of the 2026-27 season after a 4-1 loss to Tampa Bay. Dan Vladar is projected to start in goal, sharing duties with Joseph Woll. The team signed Michael Bunting and assigned Alex Bump to the AHL, while relying on Trevor Zegras to transition to a full-time No. 1 center role.

returning: detail return after completing a two-game suspension for roughing Carolina Hurricanes defenseman Sean Walker during Game 4 of the Eastern Conference First Round last season; he will replace Hodgson, a forward.
home.summary: The Senators (2-0-0) are off a 5-3 road loss to Detroit and projected to start Jonas Johansson in goal, with Linus Ullmark sidelined due to injury. Ridly Greig returns from suspension to replace scratched Hayden Hodgson. Ottawa aims to build on its strong early season start despite missing several key defenders.
